title: Crusoe sells troubled Wyoming data center project to Google
summary: The deal highlights the challenges of developing massive AI data centers.
llm_summary: Crusoe Energy Systems has off‑loaded its stalled Wyoming AI‑focused data‑center project to Google, underscoring how difficult it can be to build the massive, power‑hungry facilities that modern AI workloads demand. The sale reflects the broader industry struggle to secure cheap, reliable electricity, navigate remote site logistics and meet the high capital costs of scaling compute infrastructure
